result.title: Baxter Trophy Champions!
result.teaser_html:
Congratulations to our Baxter Trophy team who retained their title this afternoon at Hazel Grove Sports Centre, beating teams from Crewe, Chester and Wirral leagues.

Well played everyone! As winners we will be hosting again this time next year.
Photo L-R: Tom Huggon, Cat Golds, Chris Bellis, James Kee, Greg Mooney, Hannah Hernon, Rachel Flood, Anna Bellis
